title: Comparison of METS-IR and HOMA-IR for predicting new-onset CKD in middle-aged and older adults.
authors: Yoon J, Heo SJ, Lee JH, Kwon YJ, Lee JE.

Comparison of predictive power for prevalent chronic kidney disease of metabolic score for insulin resistance and homeostasis model assessment for insulin resistance. A comparison was made between the predictive powers of METS-IR and HOMA-IR for prevalent CKD in the 9261 participants at baseline using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curves.
